Name: Product Accuracy Data (Relative)
Description: This TRE contains the DPPDB product relative accuracy data. All accuracy data is based on 50% confidence (circular and linear error).

PRCE0_1.Name: DPPDB Relative CEP
PRCE0_1.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB relative CEP (0-1 nm) at 50% confidence.

PRLE0_1.Name: DPPDB Relative LEP
PRLE0_1.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB relative LEP (0-1 nm) at 50% confidence.

PRCE1_5.Name: DPPDB Relative CEP
PRCE1_5.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB relative CEP (1-5 nm) at 50% confidence.

PRLE1_5.Name: DPPDB Relative LEP
PRLE1_5.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB relative LEP (1-5 nm) at 50% confidence.

PRCE5_15.Name: DPPDB Relative CEP
PRCE5_15.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB relative CEP (5-15 nm) at 50% confidence.

PRLE5_15.Name: DPPDB Relative LEP
PRLE5_15.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB relative LEP (5-15 nm) at 50% confidence.

PRCE15_30.Name: DPPDB Relative CEP
PRCE15_30.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB relative CEP (15-30 nm) at 50% confidence.

PRLE15_30.Name: DPPDB Relative LEP
PRLE15_30.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB relative LEP (15-30 nm) at 50% confidence.

PRCE_30.Name: DPPDB Relative CEP
PRCE_30.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB relative CEP (>30 nm) at 50% confidence.

PRLE_30.Name: DPPDB Relative LEP
PRLE_30.Description: This field indicates the DPPDB relative LEP (>30 nm) at 50% confidence.
